description: Directional pushing tasks for C3 greedy-contact-mode testing. Task ID selects goal direction; all other task parameters are inherited from tasks.yaml -> pushing. Goals centered on the box init (0.45, 0) [2026-07-28b: init pulled 0.50->0.45 so east-face repos targets land near x=0.50, inside the T-proven reach zone — at 0.55+ the arm hover-stalls on wrist saturation]. Offsets 0.15 m keep every goal inside the reference workspace annulus 0.25 <= r <= 0.75.

1.name: north
1.description: Push box 15cm north. Testing whether C3 can push orthogonally to the initial approach direction.

2.name: east
2.description: Push box 15cm east (away from the arm). Contact normal aligned with goal direction. Baseline case.

3.name: south
3.description: Push box 15cm south. Orthogonal goal (opposite north).

4.name: west
4.description: Push box 15cm west (toward the arm). Contact normal anti-aligned with goal direction. Requires a contact mode switch.
